notes.title: Update 1.3 - 11.11.2021
notes.content:
- Changed the save system.
The savepoint system has been removed. Now if you quit the game your position will be saved. When you load game, you'll be in the same position when you left the game.

-Changed bounce sound.

notes.title: Update 1.2 - 29.10.2021
notes.content:
- The first stage has been facilitated.
- Fixed time format. Hours are now displayed correctly.
- Added tips such as how to move right-left without jumping.

notes.title: Update 1.1 - 10.10.2021
notes.content:
- Added new resolutions (3840x2160, 4096x2160).
- Added more space on the left and right.
- Locked Cursor - You can't click on the another monitor during the game.
